title: INT8 weight-only fallback telemetry aggregator and golden-answer delta audit
creator: Priya Nandakumar
description:
Problem: We observe intermittent small but meaningful output deltas between FP32 baseline and INT8 weight-only (GPTQ/AWQ) variants across different hardware (A100 v5 vs V100, and across kernel selection). These deltas sometimes pass existing thresholds but accumulate as customer-facing regressions for hallucination-sensitive prompts.

Goal: Build an aggregator service + test harness that collects per-request delta telemetry (golden-answer diffs, token-level divergence, log-prob shifts) from CI, canary, and nightly runs; surface aggregated drift signals; and gate rollouts via automatic rollback/fallback triggers. Integrate this into the calibration pipeline so that new quantization profiles run through an automated golden-answer delta audit before canary rollout.

Scope:
- Telemetry aggregator that normalizes diffs across models and kernel variants.
- Regression suite (golden-answer audit) that runs on a curated prompt set (sensitivity + smoke).
- Integration with shadow-canary pipeline and runtime fallback policy (route to FP32 or alternative quant profile on detection).
- Dashboard + alerts for drift > thresholds and false-positive controls.

Out of scope: per-customer private deployment integration for this sprint; long-term ML-based anomaly detection (future work).
acceptance_criteria: Aggregator ingests CI and nightly job outputs (JSON lines) and produces per-profile aggregates within 15 minutes of run completion
Golden-answer audit computes delta metrics (answer-emd, token-f1, top1-logprob-shift) and flags profiles above thresholds: answer-emd > 0.12 OR token-f1 drop > 0.06 OR top1-logprob-shift > 0.5
Canary pipeline will block promotions when drift is flagged and create automatic fallback route in routing policy to FP32-equivalent or previous quant profile
False positive rate measured on historical set is < 4% across three model families (gpt-like-7B, 13B, 70B)
Telemetry dashboard shows model/profile/kernel breakdown and includes a link to the failing PR and calibration artifacts
End-to-end tests (unit + integration) added and green in CI; a GitHub PR exists with reviewers from runtime and QA
Playbook documented with steps for manual investigation and rollback (Confluence link provided)
tasks: Design aggregator schema and normalization rules (Priya)
